summary: Panel kit 8: drop the old dialog/button sprites the kit replaced
author: client
body:
Spec step 8 (user: "Once everything is rebuilt, drop the old sprites"). Re-run the census (.claude/scratch/panel_kit/regen_proof/sprite_usage.py); drop only fully unused sprites (expected: InterfaceNdButton, InterfaceNdText, maybe Game1); list partly used ones with their remaining users.

Done when: the census shows 0 references for each dropped sprite, the client loads and every dialog draws.

**Census, 2026-11-24 (read-only researcher, hand-counted; measured from the sources):**
- Nothing is droppable today: every old game_dialogs sprite is still referenced.
- Fallback-only, so droppable once the no-kit fallbacks go: InterfaceNdText (sprite 9) and InterfaceNdIconPanel (sprite 5), plus single frames (Game1 0-2, Game2 0 and 2-6, Game3 0, Game4 1 and 7, Crusade 0, the baked Button frames).
- Still live: Game1 3-4 (sys-menu scrollbar), Game2 (shop qty buttons, skill icons, slider knob, cauldron, chat thumb), Game3 3 (item upgrade), Game4 0/2/4-6 (stat table; frames 0 and 2 are read for geometry on the kit path), Crusade, Inventory, NewExchange, MouseCursor, Button 50/61/62/69/78-81 (and rects read by draw_new_dialog_box).
- Frames cannot be cut from partly used sheets without breaking indexes (sprites are loaded by position, frames by number).
- Fallback removal touches about 25 files. get_panel_kit()/get_hud_kit() (game.cpp:3031, :3043) must become a hard load error, best done eagerly in Screen_Loading.
- staged/client/sprites/index.json lists game_dialogs with sprite_count 11 (regenerated by sources/build_tools/gen_sprite_index.py).

Proposed order: geometry reads into constants; remove fallbacks with an eager, required kit load; drop Text and IconPanel; regenerate index.json. Waiting on the user to choose scope.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** verified by the review (PASS), clean Windows and Linux builds, and bridge screenshots of the HUD and the character, magic, chat history, system menu, skill, NPC and magic shop dialogs. The missing-kit error was verified from its log line. Shop and bank were not checked by eye: they use the same frame and scrollbar code.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: Paused: the census shows only two whole sprites can go, and only after removing the fallbacks (about 25 files). Scope decision asked of the user in chat.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: User, 2026-11-25: 'Yes, remove them' (remove the no-kit fallbacks and drop InterfaceNdText and InterfaceNdIconPanel). Editor dispatched.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: User, 2026-11-25: 'And just remember to remove any unused UI sprites now'. That covers the extra drops beyond Text and IconPanel: Game1 (sprite 0) and the telescope and telescope2 folders, all at 0 references. The review passed (Opus, read-only) with no blockers. The two unused 'using namespace' nits are fixed; the bare-brace and exit-code nits are left as they are.
